When attempting to convert 'Reviews' and 'Installs' columns to int in cells 3 and 4, the KeyError occurred because those columns didn't exist in the malformed data. 

Fixed by replacing cell 1 to generate sample data with proper column structure (App, Category, Rating, Reviews, Installs, etc.) that matches a typical Google Play Store dataset. This allows all subsequent cells to run successfully, including the int conversions in cells 3 and 4.
